gen-audiowide-gf-martian-mono: Futuristic lettering, set like tiles. Audiowide keeps its strokes uniform, and Martian Mono, a monospace with fixed-width, loosely spaced letters, matches it with a gridlike structure that never wavers.
gen-audiowide-gf-matemasie: Pure tech attitude from Audiowide, whose uniform strokes and tall lowercase look like tiles laid with wide grout. And Matemasie, a sans with broad gaps between glyphs, reads clean and unhurried across many lines.
gen-audiowide-gf-menbere: Futuristic Audiowide sets tile-like letters with one flat line weight, while Menbere, a sans-serif, stacks its tall lowercase like rolled cord. Page after page, the text stays clean and quietly tidy.
gen-audiowide-gf-mukta-vaani: Mukta Vaani, a sans-serif with a high-waisted lowercase, sits beneath Audiowide, whose bold-looking and light-looking strokes never mix inside a word. Contemporary and unfussy, it keeps paragraphs moving smoothly.
gen-audiowide-gf-narnoor: Narnoor, a plain sans with short ascenders above big bowls, sits under Audiowide, whose t has a crossbar and stem of matching width. Text settles into a steady, businesslike rhythm.
gen-audiowide-gf-rambla: Fixed-nib futurism: Audiowide looks drawn with a fixed-width nib, while Rambla, a sans, lets small letters nearly reach capital height. Both fonts stand tall, and that is the draw.
gen-audiowide-gf-secular-one: Tech-forward and tile-like, Audiowide meets Secular One, a sans whose dominant midsection swallows the line's height. And Secular One, with zero modulation, keeps text blunt and steady down the screen.
gen-audiowide-gf-spline-sans-mono: Tile-like tech lettering: Audiowide runs tall in the lowercase, with uniform strokes throughout. Spline Sans Mono, a monospace with fixed-width letters and bold, uniform strokes, echoes that tallness and keeps the two locked together.
gen-audiowide-gf-tiny5: Finger-traceable tech: Audiowide holds a constant-width outline, while Tiny5, a sans-serif, has short-looking ascenders from its tall body. Text comes across clean and approachable, with a compact, sturdy feel throughout.
gen-audiowide-gf-viga: Audiowide brings the futuristic tiles, tall in the lowercase. Viga, a plain sans with hairline-free, shadow-free strokes and barely taller capitals, sits beside it like a quiet, sturdy counterweight.
